title: The Rights of Children and Their Tarbiyah upon the Deen and Akhlaq

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children upon their parents and highlights the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon salah and virtues. It also points to the necessity of teaching them the Deen and noble akhlaq (character). It emphasizes that the tarbiyah of children is a great responsibility placed upon the shoulders of the parents.

review_defects.english: the rights of children upon their parents
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'الآباء' specifically means fathers (plural of أب), not parents. The later phrase 'الوالدين' means parents, so the translation conflates the two distinct terms and broadens the scope from fathers to both parents.
